items.distractor_fact: Le thermomètre du village voisin indiquait {D} °C ce même matin.
items.gloss_en: The thermometer in the neighboring village showed {D} °C that same morning.
items.entity_note: A different thermometer, in a different village, not the one whose noon and morning readings are compared.

items.distractor_fact: L'action d'une autre entreprise cotée en bourse valait {D} € ce jour-là.
items.gloss_en: The stock of another listed company was worth {D} € that day.
items.entity_note: A different company's share price, not the one whose close and open are compared.

items.distractor_fact: En amont, le niveau d'une autre rivière atteignait {D} cm ce même soir.
items.gloss_en: Upstream, the level of another river reached {D} cm that same evening.
items.entity_note: A different river, not the one whose morning and evening levels are compared.

items.distractor_fact: Un autre randonneur, sur un sentier voisin, a relevé une altitude de {D} m à son point de départ.
items.gloss_en: Another hiker, on a nearby trail, recorded an altitude of {D} m at their starting point.
items.entity_note: A different hiker on a different trail, not the one whose two landmarks are compared.

items.distractor_fact: Sur un autre compte, le montant déposé s'élève à {D} €.
items.gloss_en: On another account, the amount deposited comes to {D} €.
items.entity_note: A different bank account, not the one whose deposit and withdrawal are compared.

items.distractor_fact: Dans un autre foyer, les dépenses mensuelles s'élèvent à {D} €.
items.gloss_en: In another household, monthly expenses come to {D} €.
items.entity_note: A different household, not the one whose income and expenses are compared.

items.distractor_fact: Le nombre de buts marqués par une autre équipe de la ligue s'élève à {D}.
items.gloss_en: The number of goals scored by another team in the league comes to {D}.
items.entity_note: A different team, not the one whose scored and conceded goals are compared.

items.distractor_fact: Une autre usine du groupe a produit {D} t ce même mois.
items.gloss_en: Another factory in the group produced {D} t that same month.
items.entity_note: A different factory with its own unstated target, not the one compared to the stated objective.

items.distractor_fact: Une autre boutique du centre commercial a réalisé un chiffre d'affaires de {D} € ce mois-ci.
items.gloss_en: Another shop in the mall achieved revenue of {D} € this month.
items.entity_note: A different shop with its own unstated target, not the one compared to the stated objective.

items.distractor_fact: Dans une région voisine, les précipitations relevées ce mois-ci s'élèvent à {D} mm.
items.gloss_en: In a neighboring region, rainfall recorded this month comes to {D} mm.
items.entity_note: A different region with its own unstated forecast, not the one compared to the stated forecast.

items.distractor_fact: Sur un autre parcours de golf, le nombre de coups joués par une golfeuse s'élève à {D}.
items.gloss_en: On another golf course, the number of strokes played by a golfer comes to {D}.
items.entity_note: A different course whose par is not stated, not the one compared to the stated par.

items.distractor_fact: Sur une autre ligne, un autre train est arrivé à {D} min après le repère de référence de cette ligne.
items.gloss_en: On another line, another train arrived at {D} min after that line's reference mark.
items.entity_note: A different train on a different line with its own timetable, not the one compared to the stated schedule.

items.distractor_fact: Dans un autre immeuble, un ascenseur s'est arrêté à un étage numéroté {D} par rapport à son propre rez-de-chaussée.
items.gloss_en: In another building, an elevator stopped at a floor numbered {D} relative to its own ground floor.
items.entity_note: A different elevator in a different building, referenced to its own ground floor.

items.distractor_fact: Un autre capteur, installé dans une commune voisine, indiquait un niveau de {D} m par rapport à son propre repère de référence.
items.gloss_en: Another sensor, installed in a neighboring town, showed a level of {D} m relative to its own reference mark.
items.entity_note: A different sensor with its own reference mark, not the one compared here.

items.distractor_fact: Une troisième tour, dans un autre quartier, culmine à une hauteur de {D} m.
items.gloss_en: A third tower, in another neighborhood, stands at a height of {D} m.
items.entity_note: A different tower in a different neighborhood, not the East or West tower being compared.
